entities.name: King David
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Second king of Israel (c. 1010–970 BCE), shepherd, warrior, poet, and "man after God's own heart." Conquered Jerusalem and made it his capital, received the Davidic covenant (2 Samuel 7) promising an eternal dynasty, and authored many Psalms. Ancestor of Jesus in the NT genealogy.
